note: Submodule of Dashboards. Provides one Dashboard plugin, comments_statistic ('Comment per node type.', category Statistics), a chart of comment count per content type (settings key 'count' = totalcount|daycount) sourced from comment_entity_statistics. It is exposed as block dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic and placed in a dashboard's Layout Builder. Medium/hard cases build/read a dashboard config entity whose Layout Builder section contains that widget block (and its count setting), verified by loading the dashboard storage and scanning section component configuration via drush.

evals.prompt: What dashboard widget does the dashboards_comments submodule add, and what does it display?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'comments_statistic' Dashboard plugin ('Comment per node type.', category Statistics): a chart of the number of comments per content type, from comment_entity_statistics.

evals.prompt: How do you place the dashboards_comments comment-statistics widget onto a dashboard — what block plugin id is it exposed as?
evals.expected_output: Every Dashboard plugin is exposed as a block; you add block dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic into the dashboard's Layout Builder section.

evals.prompt: The dashboards_comments widget has a setting that controls which comment counts it sums. What is it and what values does it accept?
evals.expected_output: The 'count' setting accepts 'totalcount' (all-time) or 'daycount' (daily), selecting the comment_entity_statistics column summed per node type.

evals.prompt: On this site a dashboard (id dc_probe) has been built with a dashboards_comments widget. Inspect the dashboard configuration and state the block plugin id of the comment widget it contains.
evals.expected_output: The dc_probe dashboard's section contains the block dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic. Read with `drush cget dashboards.dashboard.dc_probe` or by loading the dashboard and scanning its sections.

evals.prompt: Inspect the dc_probe dashboard on this site and report the 'count' setting configured on its comment-statistics (dashboards_comments) widget.
evals.expected_output: The comments_statistic component on dc_probe has count = daycount. Found in the dashboard's section component configuration.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'dc_task_a' and add the dashboards_comments comment-per-node-type widget to it (block dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic) in a Layout Builder section. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard dc_task_a exists and one of its Layout Builder section components has configuration id 'dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'dc_task_b' containing the dashboards_comments widget (dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic) configured to show DAILY comment counts (its count setting set to 'daycount'). Apply it live.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard dc_task_b has a dashboards_block:dashboard:comments_statistic component whose configuration.count === 'daycount'.
